description: This PHP source file manages user role assignments for test projects and test plans within the TestLink test management system. It includes functions for initializing arguments, checking user permissions, retrieving effective roles, and updating user roles, along with UI rendering logic.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the TestLink system, providing methods for retrieving user details and roles.

classes.name: tlRole
classes.description: Represents a user role in the system, with methods to retrieve role details and check permissions.

methods.name: testlinkInitPage
methods.description: Initializes necessary configurations for a TestLink page.

methods.name: tlUser::getAll
methods.description: Fetches all user records with specified details.

methods.name: checkRightsForUpdate
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has rights to update roles for a given test project/test plan.

methods.name: getTestProjectEffectiveRoles
methods.description: Retrieves effective roles for a test project considering current user's permissions.

methods.name: getTestPlanEffectiveRoles
methods.description: Retrieves effective roles for a test plan considering current user's permissions.

methods.name: getGrantsForUserMgmt
methods.description: Fetches grants available to the user for role management.

methods.name: init_labels
methods.description: Initializes UI labels for role assignment messages.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Performs the update of user roles for a specified feature.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Sets up GUI configuration for role assignment page.
